description: This is a C source file for a Linux kernel module related to PTM (Packet Transfer Mode) driver functions, including proc filesystem interface and debug/test functionalities for VR9 platform.

methods.name: proc_file_create
methods.description: Creates proc entries for memory and pp32 control interfaces.

methods.name: proc_file_delete
methods.description: Removes proc entries for memory and pp32 control interfaces.

methods.name: sb_addr_to_fpi_addr_convert
methods.description: Converts buffer address to FPI address if below a certain threshold.

methods.name: proc_write_mem
methods.description: Handles writing commands to read/write memory via proc interface.

methods.name: proc_read_pp32
methods.description: Reads debug/status information of the PP32 cores for debugging.

methods.name: proc_write_pp32
methods.description: Handles commands to control and set breakpoints on PP32 cores.

methods.name: strincmp
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison up to n characters.

methods.name: get_number
methods.description: Parses numeric values from command strings, supporting hex and decimal.

methods.name: ignore_space
methods.description: Skips whitespace and delimiters in command parsing.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_test_init
methods.description: Kernel module initialization, creates proc entries.

methods.name: ifx_ptm_test_exit
methods.description: Kernel module cleanup, deletes proc entries.
